title: Curry Cauliflower Polish Sausage
description: A flavorful curry dish made with polish sausage, cauliflower, and vibrant spices.

ingredients.name: Polish sausage
ingredients.notes: any type of polish sausage is fine

ingredients.name: Cauliflower
ingredients.notes: you can use frozen cauliflower too

instructions: 2. Cook the polish sausage in a pan over medium heat until browned, then set aside.
3. In the same pan, add the olive oil and sauté the chopped onion until softened.
4. Add the minced garlic and curry powder to the pan and cook for another minute.
5. Add the cauliflower to the pan and cook until it starts to soften.
6. Add the cooked polish sausage back to the pan and stir to combine.
7. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
8. Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and roast in the oven for 20-25 minutes.
